lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular grid of high-luminance circular spots arranged in vertical columns, with approximately 12 columns visible between the posterior gill slit and the tail base along the mid-flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of higher pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of blobs, forming a lattice of anchor nodes most distinct in the region below the first dorsal fin.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three parallel horizontal ridges are visible on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient transition from high-intensity (light) on the dorsal edge to low-intensity (shadow) on the ventral edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Sparse distribution of approximately 5-7 low-luminance blobs concentrated primarily in the lower-posterior quadrant of the first dorsal fin silhouette.

other_distinctive_markers: A pair of elongated, low-luminance silhouettes (remoras) are positioned ventrally to the mid-section of the shark's flank.
